IT GOES THROUGH, IN ORDER
Its slot. Its slot is made from the tag’s commit. A release from before Nova could run one in a sandbox stops here.
Its tests. Its own tests run (npm test, unless the supervisor was started with another command), for up to 30 minutes.
Sandbox start. It starts on a copy of your home, with no work, no network peers and no secrets.
Smoke probes. Five probes must answer on that copy: health, setup, the Work Ledger, memory and problems.
The switch. Nova takes a checkpoint of your home, stops, and starts the new release on it. Nova restarts here.
Canary window. Health is checked on your home every 5 seconds for 2 minutes. If it fails, Nova goes back by itself.
Promoted. It is live, and v0.1.0-alpha.3 is kept to go back to.

If its tests, the sandbox or a probe fails, nothing changes: Nova keeps running v0.1.0-alpha.3. If your database is upgraded at the switch, the backup from before is kept.
